products.body_html:
Scent, without a machine.

No heat. No electricity. No water. The porous lava rock absorbs your oil and releases it slowly on its own.

Four or five drops of Relax is all it takes at the end of the day. That is the entire routine.

How to use: 

Add 4-5 drops of oil directly onto the lava rock and set it down somewhere you spend time. That's it — nothing to plug in, fill, or switch on.

Essential oils naturally dissipate into the air over time. Add more drops as needed to customize the strength of the aroma and how long it lasts.

It needs no power and no water, so it sits happily on a bench, a shelf or a bedside table. Do not set it on or against a heating element, and do not pour oil onto a heater or hot rocks.

The lava rock never needs cleaning or replacing. Wipe the beech wood base with a dry or barely damp cloth — do not submerge it. To change scents, let the rock sit until the current oil fades, then add the new one.

products.title: SaunaBoxers: 100% Cotton Fertility Cooling Sauna Briefs
products.body_html:
You already do the work. You show up to the sauna. You put in the sessions.
But here's what most guys don't know: every time you sit in that heat without protection, you're cooking the one part of your body that needs to stay cool. Scrotal temperature directly affects sperm quality, testosterone production, and overall reproductive health.
SaunaBoxers are built for the guy who refuses to compromise. Made from 100% cotton, these briefs feature an ergonomic ice pack that keeps things cool where it counts. You get the full benefit of your sauna session without the hidden cost. This isn't a gimmick. It's the missing piece of your routine.


Key Features & Benefits

•Made with 100% Cotton
•Ergonomic Ice Pack Included: Pre-shaped to fit naturally in the front pouch without shifting or bunching. Lasts 20-30 minutes per session.
•Shields Fertility & Testosterone: Keeps scrotal temperature in a safe range to protect sperm quality and reproductive health from high heat damage.
•Built for High Heat: The ergonomic fit and cotton construction are specifically designed for the demands of regular sauna use.
•HSA/FSA Eligible: Purchase using your HSA/FSA funds through TrueMed®.

Materials: 

  • Body Fabric: 100% organic cotton
  • Waistband/Trim: Elastic blend
  • Cooling Insert: Removable cooling ice pack

Organic cotton fabric is sourced from a GOTS-certified textile supplier.

Ice-Pack: IMO Certified Non-Hazardous · SGS Safety Data Sheet Compliant

How It Works

Sperm production requires a temperature roughly 2-4°F below core body temperature. When scrotal temperature rises consistently during sauna sessions, the environment for sperm development becomes less optimal.
SaunaBoxers™ let you keep your sauna habit without the trade-off.
1.Freeze: Place the ergonomic ice pack in the freezer for at least 2 hours before your session.
2.Insert: Slide the ice pack into the targeted front pouch of the SaunaBoxers™.
3.Sweat: Enjoy your 20-30 minute sauna session while keeping your most sensitive zone protected and cool.


What's Included in Every Order?

•SaunaBoxers Underwear (100% Cotton)
•Ergonomic Ice Pack 
•1-Year Warranty
•Free US Shipping


Care Instructions

Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle. Tumble dry low or hang dry. Do not bleach. The organic cotton holds its shape and softness wash after wash.
Note: The ice pack is not machine washable. Simply wipe it down with a damp cloth and return it to the freezer.

Disclaimers:


Health & Use Disclaimer
SaunaBoxers are a wellness accessory designed to provide targeted cooling comfort during sauna use. They are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, prevent, or mitigate any disease or medical condition. Results may vary. SaunaBoxers do not guarantee changes to fertility, sperm quality, testosterone levels, or reproductive outcomes. Consult a qualified healthcare professional if you have concerns about fertility, testosterone, reproductive health, circulation issues, diabetes, reduced skin sensitivity, or any medical condition before use.

Fertility Disclaimer
Heat exposure may affect scrotal temperature, and scrotal temperature can play a role in the environment where sperm develop. SaunaBoxers are designed to help reduce localized heat exposure during sauna sessions, but they are not a fertility treatment and do not guarantee protection from heat-related reproductive effects.

Cooling Insert Safety
Do not apply the frozen insert directly to bare skin. Use only inside the designated pouch. Discontinue use immediately if you experience numbness, burning, pain, irritation, excessive cold, or discomfort. Do not use while sleeping. Do not use a damaged, leaking, punctured, or swollen insert.

products.title: SaunaBox® SmartSteam Pro
products.body_html:
Your personal wellness oasis, available anytime, anywhere. 

Designed with your convenience and comfort in mind, this portable sauna delivers the full rejuvenating experience of a traditional sauna, revolutionized into a compact and easy-to-use package. It's relaxation, redefined.

The SAUNABOX heats up internally to over 130-140° F with a near 100% humidity. Because of how water conducts heat, the high humidity evokes similar physiological effects at a lower internal temperature as a dry sauna would at over 160°+. The condensed area and continuous flow of heat into the sauna without pause also helps to increase the level of heat. You can adjust heat level and duration settings directly on the SmartSteam unit and by remote control.

Every inch of this steam sauna has been thoughtfully crafted. The premium, insulating materials help to create a soothing, enveloping heat, while the durable fiberglass frame ensures that this sauna is your companion for the long haul.

Easy to set up and take down, this portable sauna is your wellness journey's most versatile companion and includes everything you need to set up your sauna.

Can be used both indoors and outdoors. If you leave it outdoors, we recommend having an appropriate cover such as a canopy, balcony, tarp, etc.
